title: The Root-Crowned Gate: Hidden Law
description: The Root-Crowned Gate unfolds across root-crowned gate hollowed beneath silver branches, pushing a 5-Titan Tuatha squad to prove adaptation, healing, roots, terrain control, endurance through life systems. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: The Root-Crowned Gate: Hidden Law advances Roots Below the Gate: Avalora reveals that Gate wounds can be healed only if living terrain is treated as ally, witness, and battlefield at once. It directly tests the faction tension: Their memory is power, but it can become vengeance when old wounds refuse to compost.
